course_period.name: course_period
course_period.value: "course"."start_date" IS NULL OR "course"."end_date" IS NULL OR "course"."start_date" <= "course"."end_date"

discount_value.name: discount_value
discount_value.value: "discount"."rate_bps" IS NOT NULL OR "discount"."amount_cents" IS NOT NULL

invitation_content.name: invitation_content
invitation_content.value: ("invitation"."type" = 'invitation' AND "invitation"."role" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invitation"."type" = 'reinitialisation' AND "invitation"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)
